## Description

*Opened by [@XtraCube](https://github.com/XtraCube)* *on Apr 5, 2026*


I've faced a couple issues with the UI on my iPhone 11 with the current latest release of Lara. I'm on iOS 17.3.1. So far heres what i got:

- The icons for file manager and logs are missing completely
- Tools page loads fine until I run sandbox escape, then its blank. See the attached image for the log
- I can't find the font overwrite anywhere?
- The files manager page will crash sometimes when I try to open it
